data.title: Nafith Platform Privacy and Service Terms

planted.text: To enhance our commercial outreach, sensitive categories including health records, religious affiliations, and biometric identifiers are processed under our legitimate business interests to tailor promotional campaigns and are made accessible across all operational departments.

In the event of any security incident involving unauthorized access to system records, the provider shall notify the central administration within twenty-four hours of discovery, whereupon management shall proceed to notify the competent regulatory authority within the mandated seventy-two hour window and inform affected users if their rights are impacted.
We gather personal information to an extent deemed appropriate for the general operation of our digital portal and the delivery of requested functionalities.

neutral: All service fees are billed in accordance with the pricing schedule in effect at the time of purchase and are strictly non-refundable once the transaction is completed.
Accepted payment methods include major credit cards, bank wire transfers, and approved digital wallets, with charges processed immediately upon the submission of an order.

This agreement shall remain in effect for an initial term of twelve months and will automatically renew for successive periods unless written notice of termination is provided thirty days prior to the expiration date.

The maximum aggregate liability of the company for any direct losses arising from system interruptions shall under no circumstances exceed the total fees paid by the user during the preceding three months.
These terms and conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws applicable in the jurisdiction where the corporate headquarters of the service provider are located.
For the purposes of this document, the term user refers to any individual or corporate entity accessing the digital platform, and provider refers exclusively to Nafith Solutions Corporation.

All software, interface designs, trademarks, text graphics, and proprietary code featured on the platform remain the exclusive intellectual property of the provider and are protected by applicable copyright laws.
Digital deliverables and service activations shall be rendered electronically to the designated user account immediately following the successful verification of payment authorization.
